headline: Linn of Mercy Erupts Afresh as Mooring County Stirs
war_summary: Since our last dispatch, the violent epicenter has consolidated upon Linn of Mercy, where ferocious fighting claimed over four thousand casualties in two hours and produced five fresh base transfers around Outwich Ranch. Mooring County, previously reported quiet, abruptly stirred with three strategic base actions of its own in the latest watch. Meanwhile, the rampant territorial turnover across Palantine Berm has paused, logging zero base changes in the past two hours though heavy exchanges still cost nearly fourteen hundred men. A similar stalemate grips the blood-soaked ground of Weathered Expanse, where over thirty-five hundred combined casualties fell in two hours without a single fortification changing hands. Frontline base exchanges have likewise ceased across Marban Hollow and the Nevish Line, cooling after earlier upheavals despite steady local skirmishing. Across the southern rim and rearward theaters, quiet persists as logistics and garrisons hold under negligible pressure.
